props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value of the input. Use when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Event handler called when the selected value of the input changes.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the input. Use when controlled.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component’s state.

props.name: type
props.description: The type of the input element. It determines the kind of data that can be entered.

props.name: render
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component’s HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
Accepts a ReactElement or a function that returns the element to render.
